asr.full_text: We have a special day. Another special day on MLM news. We introduce to you Mr. Juha Parhiala. When I met the three persons who were in Dubai at the Dubai event we had for six or seven weeks ago, they really convinced me that, Joao, if you come to Romania, we're going to put Romania on fire. And I'm so pleased and so amazed to see 300-400 people here today and I will really come back very soon. We are going to do a next event. The next event will not only be a special event for Romania, it's going to be the first recognition event where people hit the rankings of ruby and emerald. They will receive their iPhones, they will receive their MacBooks. And I promise next time I come, I will not come alone. I will have Dr. Ruxia with me. That would be very nice. Thank you. You said something very interesting during the event. Network marketing is about relationships. Can you tell something more about this for our visitors? Yeah. I've been in this industry for so long time and what I have found out over the years as a top networker that if you don't have a relationship with the people you're working with, they're going to stop working with you. They will move to another company or another company They think the grass is green on another way They can never ever ever be so patient, many, many great leaders even miss their own success in the company Because they stop the business and goes on somewhere else But if you have relationship with the leaders, so your sponsor or your mentor You're building also a relationship with the leader or your sponsor, your mentor.. you are building also the relationship with the company The thing is that when you starting to build the relation with the person its taking time, it is not 5 seconds to chat on a Facebook or something like that My leaders, whom I have with me in OneCoin, they are people known to me for 15-20 years. Some of them. The thing is that they are following me because they make money from other companies. I stopped working with companies because of two reasons If they don't pay the commission or they can't deliver the the products then we have a problem. Me as a leader is responsible for my leaders or the people I have really really relation with and then I can always say hey guys, hey girls this is the situation with this company we are working on. I check out some other options. Are you interested in following me because today we have the problem with commission. Today we have the problem with commissions so today we have the problems with that country they cannot deliver but let me find out another company who really can stand and deliver what you want um so long time I have done this industry so the first thing now I really find a company not it's only in my brain it's in my heart and we have a long-term business. We don't have to deliver products we do a digital everything so we are borderless whoever wherever you live in the world for a moment and whoever you have the relationship with you don't have to worry about if this product will be delivered to him in time or it's going to take time, he knows that in one of a second he gets registered in his position he will have the package. He can directly start to do the education and take the business to the next level. That is to build with a relationship. It seems that you trust this company, because one coin and cryptocurrency, generally speaking, is considered risky investment? If you read what banks are talking about, cryptocurrency is a risky business. Why? Because cryptocurrency is not regulated today anywhere in the world. That means that banks and all financing institutions are a little bit afraid of cryptocurrency. But the other way, people know the bitcoins' story, and that's what is most important. If it's risky or not risky, only the future will tell us. But one thing is that cryptocurrency is here to stay on cryptocurrency will be the next transfer of money all over the world. But also going to be the next big thing that you don't need to use your credit cards in a shop or internet show you using cryptocurrency. It's safe! Nobody can steal your cryptocurrency and OneCoin is a real deal! We have everything. We have our block change, we have auditorium, we have our mining process, we have our education and doctor Roosha she have already planned for year one, year two, or year three to the company, and have the structure. I don't think cryptocurrency is risky, I have dealt with cryptocurrency in many years. And I have never seen a risky business in it. But when people around think it's risky, I tell them, okay, wait and see. And start the day you are comfortable with cryptocurrency but do your homework, read about cryptocurrency, what is real and what is not real and when you find the real whatever company are gonna do with cryptocurrency when you are comfortable that this is a real doing, do it because whatever company started in cryptocurrency what is real. It's gonna be the next generation of credit cards. Thank you. Still one message. Do you have one message for our website visitors, network marketers from different companies. This is a message I want to tell everybody, many people looking for a new thing they don't know if they're going to go to that company or that company, or that company. If you are comfortable where you are today, and you see the future, this is the company I can build, stay there! But if you're looking for something new, and would like to take some challenge in your life and be the next coming millionaire in Romania look at the cryptocurrencies industry, look at the 1coin industry what we have done for the last eight months there is a reason that 420,000 people already registered in 8 month. We are the fastest growing network company in the world. So, if you want to look a good business, risky or not risky, few shall we say but one thing is for sure one coin is a real deal. Thank you very much. Thank you.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin as “a real deal” and encourages viewers to pursue it as a business and become the “next coming millionaire,” while presenting rank-based iPhone and MacBook rewards and rapid registration growth as reasons to participate. The speaker describes network marketing through relationships with leaders, sponsors, and mentors, showing a recruitment-dependent hierarchy rather than ordinary cryptocurrency commentary. The interview is promotional and does not investigate or criticize the offer.
